assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia as a potential etiology for transient cerebral ischemic events
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities
The service is required to determine whether a paroxysmal arrhythmia is the underlying cause of the patient's transient cerebral ischemic events
The denial under CO-22 is premature because clinical necessity has been clearly established
There is no indication that primary liability has been satisfied
